newsitem.title: FINLAND: Aamulehti repeats sees 1996 op profit up.
newsitem.headline: Aamulehti repeats sees 1996 op profit up.

text.p: Finnish media group Aamulehti-Yhtyma on Wednesday repeated an earlier forecast that its operating profitabiliity would rise in 1996.

"Net sales are expected to rise to the level of 1,600 million markka in the current (year) and the operating profit is expected to be better than last year," it said in a statement with its January-August interim result.
In 1995, Aamulehti posted a 122 million markka operating profit and its net sales were 1.43 billion markka.
In the first eight months of this year, its net sales were 1.03 billion markka and its operating profit 79 million markka, down from 82 million in the first eight months of last year.
